findings.description: Setting AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY exposes a sensitive credential that may be logged in shell history
findings.remediation: Use a secrets manager or credential file instead of environment variables.
findings.title: Sensitive credential exported: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

findings.description: A network command uploads sensitive credential or wallet material to a remote sink
findings.remediation: Verify the upload destination is trusted. Review what data is being sent.
findings.title: Data exfiltration via curl upload
